lean.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x a : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖a‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x a) a ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x a) a ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖a‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1, p.1 + Real.sqrt η • p.2))
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let ν := J.snd
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2 : ℝ) • x - y)) ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun u => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+u)) - ‖y-u‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      ∀ (f : E → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f →
        let Tf := fun y => ∫ u, f u ∂S y
        Differentiable ℝ Tf ∧ MemLp f 2 ν ∧ MemLp Tf 2 ν ∧
        MemLp (gradient Tf) 2 ν ∧
        Integrable (fun y =>
          AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.variance
            (S y) f) ν ∧
        (∫ y, AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.variance
          (S y) f ∂ν) = (∫ y, (f y)^2 ∂ν) - (∫ y, (Tf y)^2 ∂ν) ∧
        η * (∫ y, ‖gradient Tf y‖^2 ∂ν) ≤
          (1-(α : ℝ)*η)^2/(4*(1+(α : ℝ)*η)) *
            ((∫ y, (f y)^2 ∂ν) - (∫ y, (Tf y)^2 ∂ν))
approved_definition_context: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its norm and Borel measurable structure, including rank zero.

V is globally twice continuously real Frechet differentiable; the evaluated second derivative is its genuine Hessian. alpha,beta are nonnegative reals with 0<alpha<=beta and alpha norm(a)^2<=D2V(x)[a,a]<=beta norm(a)^2 for every x,a.

eta is positive and beta*eta<=1. volume is canonicalvolume; Measure.tilted uses the exponential of the specified function divided by its genuine Bochner normalizer. Probability of each actual law is an output.
stdGaussian E is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian. J is the literal pushforward of mu product Gaussian by (x,g)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)g). nu=J.snd is its actual second marginal.

Kernel E E is measurable; IsMarkovKernel says everyfiber is aprobability. IsCondKernel for swappedJ means its firstmarginalcompProdR equals swappedJ. One commonR/S is produced beforeall observations; every-yreflection and explicitnormalizedS density are outputs.
f is real-valued globallysmooth withcompactsupport. Tf(y) is the literal Bochnerintegral of f under S(y), not an arbitrary conditional representative.

Differentiable Tf is globaltrue Frechetdifferentiability. gradient is inverseRiesz applied to its genuine realFrechetderivative. MemLp g2nu means genuine AEstrongmeasurability and finiteL2 seminorm against actualnu.

Poincare.variance(S y)f is exactly the Bochnerintegral under S(y) of (f(u)-integral f dS(y))^2. The theorem outputs its integrability under nu and the exact outeridentity integralVar=integralf^2nu-integralTf^2nu.

The squared gradient energy is integrated against the sameactualnu, multipliedbyeta and bounded by exactly (1-alphaeta)^2/[4(1+alphaeta)] times that squared-normdefect. There is no supplied law/domain/energy/variance/bound certificate among public assumptions.
